name: cryptolens
label: Cryptolens
description: Cryptolens is a Software Licensing as a Service (SLaaS) platform that provides developers with tools to manage software licenses, protect against piracy, and analyze usage data.

token.label: Access Token
token.description: Your Cryptolens access token. Get it from https://app.cryptolens.io/User/AccessToken

addCustomer.label: Add Customer
addCustomer.description: Add a new customer to your Cryptolens account

name.label: Name
name.description: The name of the customer (max 100 characters)

email.label: Email
email.description: The email of the customer (max 100 characters)

companyName.label: Company Name
companyName.description: The company name the customer belongs to (max 100 characters)

enableCustomerAssociation.label: Enable Customer Portal
enableCustomerAssociation.description: If enabled, a portal link will be returned where the customer can view their licenses

allowActivationManagement.label: Allow Activation Management
allowActivationManagement.description: If enabled, the customer can activate and deactivate devices through the customer portal

allowMultipleUserAssociation.label: Allow Multiple User Association
allowMultipleUserAssociation.description: If enabled, multiple user accounts can be associated with this customer

blockKey.label: Block Key
blockKey.description: Block a license key to prevent it from being accessible by most Web API methods

key.label: License Key
key.description: The serial key string to block

createKey.label: Create Key
createKey.description: Create a new license key for a product

period.label: Validity Period (days)
period.description: The number of days from today the license key should be valid. Default is 0 (no expiration).

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: Additional notes about the license key (max 500 characters)

block.label: Block Key
block.description: Block the key from being accessed by the Activation method

customerId.label: Customer ID
customerId.description: The ID of the customer to associate with this license key

maxNoOfMachines.label: Max Number of Machines
maxNoOfMachines.description: The maximum number of computers that can activate the key. Default is 0 (unlimited).

allowedMachines.label: Allowed Machines
allowedMachines.description: A list of machine codes (separated by new lines) that will be prioritized during activation

resellerId.label: Reseller ID
resellerId.description: The ID of the reseller to associate with this license key

noOfKeys.label: Number of Keys
noOfKeys.description: The number of keys to generate. Default is 1. Maximum 1000 per request.

extendLicense.label: Extend License
extendLicense.description: Extend a license key by a specified number of days

key.label: License Key
key.description: The serial key string to extend

noOfDays.label: Number of Days
noOfDays.description: The number of days to extend the license. Use negative numbers to decrease the expiration date.
